title: Native desk infrastructure review for Aster Desk
review_mode: Read-only source tracing; no app source edits, production actions, remote service tests or strategy design.
excluded: Strategies, scanners, signals, ranking, indicators, allocation policies
summary: Reuse durable operational evidence and lifecycle patterns, rather than existing trading decisions. ChatGPT has the most explicit durable scheduling and browser-task boundary; Sable has a process-worker and full paper-book facade; Author supplies file-worker/receipt patterns with important health-claim limits; Femto is a published read-only surface. None is an existing general six-agent operational task desk.

runtime.statement: TanStack React Start/Vite server application. The worker uses a process-global 30-second interval, 15-second watchdog, per-process in-flight flag and persisted heartbeat. It loops onboarded books and records per-cycle reports. This is a bounded deterministic desk worker, not a generic durable task queue or distributed agent scheduler.

task_agent_model.statement: Cassius duty contracts describe permitted reads/actions and paper-only boundaries. The terminal actually reads persisted books, obtains completed daily paths and a read-only Alpaca MCP probe, assembles a structured view and writes a diary card. The Cassius CLI calls those HTTP operations; its name/comment does not implement a separate reasoning agent.

Optional Grok 4.5 performs one constrained prose-to-schema interpretation when configured. Missing/model-failed cases return the deterministic interpretation. This call is not a autonomous tool loop, task delegation system or continuous public-news researcher.

A separate bounded Edge/scout cycle is genuinely implemented: scheduled/manual cadence gating, public Yahoo/calendar/headline reads, structured SEEN/INFERRED/missing-evidence brief and durable policy/brief records. Optional Skyvern can launch one read-only Yahoo-page task with an eight-step budget and cooldown; this path records a launch URL rather than establishing a completed browser result. Optional paper hands are a separate deterministic desk-action path, not free-form model control.

persistence.statement: PostgreSQL when DATABASE_URL is configured; otherwise PGlite on a disk directory. A per-user JSON snapshot is projected into account/event/order/fill/position/bracket tables. Event idempotency and fill IDs preserve receipts; cycle reports persist input freshness and resulting entity IDs. Snapshot projections are sequential writes, not one transaction over the whole book.

paper_accounting.statement: Local paper fills update cash, quantity, weighted average and marked equity. The simulator applies explicit simulated slippage. Connected Alpaca-paper orders remain pending until broker evidence reports fills, and reconciliation refreshes account/positions. Simulator values and broker values are distinct paths; the existing numeric/rounding model is not a Decimal accounting foundation to copy.

data_truth.statement: Provider-derived quotes come from completed bars; absent history is not synthesized into live-read evidence. Demo/live-read/stale modes, provider fetch time, completed-bar time and worker time are tracked separately. Quote/print marks can fall back to cost when no quote exists, so marked equity should retain missing-mark provenance.

lifecycle_limits.statement: A local preview GET starts the process timer. Other GETs can perform an opportunistic sweep when the heartbeat is stale. The Vercel scheduled endpoint is one daily pulse, whose branch writes a running heartbeat and returns before performing a sweep. Source therefore does not establish uninterrupted unattended production operation.

Pause/park blocks new work while existing protection evaluation remains enabled. UI pause/resume mutates a local clone and saves it; the worker tries to merge concurrent events/orders, but this is not a fenced generic task state machine.

operator_controls.statement: The UI exposes pause/resume, approvals, manual paper tickets, cancellations, position closes, broker sync and freshness/worker health. These are real server/store operations, not decorative activity cards.

repositories.deployment_evidence: Reviewed pinned source only. No current running process, configured broker, external Grok availability or production uptime was tested.

runtime.statement: Main route renders AutopilotDesk. The Cloudflare Worker scheduled handler invokes the desk sweep and outbox dispatcher; source configuration supplies a five-minute cron. Active saved desks are dispatched independently of browser requests. Runtime deployment/configuration was not observed remotely.

task_agent_model.statement: Saved prompt/mandate versions are durable objects. The mandate compiler is explicitly deterministic. Research runs, observations and execution decisions are bounded application jobs, not free-form agents with arbitrary tools.

Optional Skyvern is a real external browser-task boundary with persisted lifecycle/result/proposals. It defaults disabled and OBSERVE; enabled/configured tasks can propose only enumerated actions. Server gates apply paper actions according to explicit approval or PAPER_AUTOMATIC. This is not an unrestricted agent or a live-broker capability.

persistence.statement: D1 records versioned desks, run/context/observation/candidate provenance, audit events and paper decision→intent→fill→protection→reconciliation→outcome links. Worker leases are per desk/window, expire after four minutes and fence completion by token. Stable run IDs allow retrying a window without inventing a new history entry. Health, bounded retry budget, provider cooldown, dead letters and notification outbox expose real failure states.

paper_accounting.statement: PaperLedgerAdapter submits a PENDING handle and fills only from a later completed REAL_DATA bar supplied by the server. Cumulative fill quantities cannot move backward/overfill or rewrite terminal states. Order/fill/protection are committed together; position projection is updated afterward and failures are recorded as reconciliation mismatches.

Positions track weighted cost and realized P&L; exposure is reconstructed from durable open positions plus unfilled pending intents. The risk row has a seeded/cached account_equity value, and position market_value initially reflects cost. This is not a complete independent funding/cash/equity accounting ledger.

data_truth.statement: Yahoo requests are bounded, cached and try a secondary origin. Bars are filtered to completed intervals; source status/provider health and retrieved/completed timestamps remain explicit. Anonymous preview is a labeled fixture; saved desks can request provider-backed runs. A preview/compiled mandate is not evidence that real work executed.

lifecycle_limits.statement: Separate controls exist for whole-desk active/paused status and paper-risk entry pause/park/kill switch. The scheduled query processes only active desks; risk pause still allows the active desk to settle protection/orders. These scopes should be explicit in a generic operational desk.

operator_controls.statement: Compile/accept/save/version/compare/export, run preview or server research, desk pause/resume, entry controls, paper review/cancel-replace, and optional browser-task run/status/review are implemented UI routes. They depend on durable saved owner-scoped objects; no general task inbox or six-agent operational handoff UI is present.

repositories.deployment_evidence: Reviewed pinned source and configuration. No deployed D1 contents, cron delivery, model connection, Skyvern session or paper-provider operation was tested.

repositories.summary: Deterministic Node/file workdesk with JSON persisted book/receipts, PID locks and heartbeat/watchdog recovery. Both repos preserve the same tree. Current halt flags disable paper execution and publishing; some workers still operate. LIVE_CLOCK=zero is not a global process halt. Status literals/same-day scan stamps and successful workflow exits do not independently prove delivery.
portable_patterns: Single publisher and recorded external delivery receipts
limits: Do not reuse literal renderer health or heartbeat-as-delivery semantics
Archived book snapshot is not current broker truth

repositories.summary: Published static HTML terminals and a JSON feed. The browser fetches/render snapshots with fallback and freshness labels. No agent runner, task producer, ledger writer, order handling or enforcement source is present here.
portable_patterns: Read-only desk visibility with timestamped provenance
Retain last known snapshot on feed failure while making age visible
Operator-facing book, activity, pending-work and review surfaces
limits: Feed freshness is not engine or broker health
Published values were not reconciled independently
Saved GitHub Pages success supports publication of this commit, not present live operation

patterns_for_strategy_free_desk.pattern: Durable task and ordered attempt/step history
patterns_for_strategy_free_desk.application: Store queued/running/completed/failed/cancelled operational work; identify each worker attempt and actor. A display card or event row alone is not an agent task.
Persist a lease/token or equivalent single-worker exclusion, bound attempts and recover expired in-flight work. Keep stable task/effect identities across retries.
Reconcile human funding and recorded fills into cash, reserved cash, positions, cost and realized P&L. Commit reservation/fill effects atomically using exact monetary values.

patterns_for_strategy_free_desk.pattern: Truthful empty state and evidence clocks
patterns_for_strategy_free_desk.application: Start with zero funding/positions/orders/strategies. Preserve manual quote source, as-of time, ingestion time, missing/stale marks and the time a task actually completed.

Operational local workers can audit/reconcile/journal without a model. Show reasoning configuration and observed task results separately; only explicit brief/note requests may call the optional provider.
Agents report pending intents and operational gaps. They cannot fund accounts, create strategy decisions or approve/fill human orders.
Expose last successful effect, last attempt, active lease, error/degraded state and evidence age. A running timer, green workflow exit or recent HTTP pulse is insufficient proof of delivery.
Pause prevents new recurring cycles; manual tasks remain available. Cancellation stops future steps while preserving already completed receipts and history.
Record actor/time/object transitions and source references. Preserve settings, tasks, quotes, account facts and receipts in a portable export.

implemented: Deterministic bounded desk work and explicit cycle/receipt persistence
Optional constrained Grok mandate interpretation in Sable
Sable bounded public-data scout briefs and optional one-page Skyvern launch; a launch is not a completed browser result
Optional configured Skyvern browser tasks in ChatGPT, with server-applied enumerated paper actions
not_established: A common durable agent/task inbox spanning these repos
Current deployed uptime or enabled model/broker connections
Full accounting solely from cached risk/equity or published feed values
actual_agent_capabilities_and_limits.new_desk_boundary: The six Aster roles should be actual operational task steps, not strategy labels. Local automation, optional reasoning, human accounting/order operations and immutable evidence must remain distinct.

limitations: Focused infrastructure source review, not every line of these repositories.
No remote deployed services or production effects were exercised.
Companion Author/Femto reports preserve their deeper source paths and exact implementation/publication distinctions.
